resolutions.why_not_branch_a: [SUPERSEDED under PR #57 R5 — see `corrections`. The original text was: 'Acceptance (a)'s own cheaper route was evaluated concretely and FALSIFIED, not declined on preference. It offered "a check that the `low_item_coverage` message's percentage equals `meta.coverage`". `low_item_coverage` fires on exactly one committed document, `xref-index-collapse`, and that document carries ZERO incorporated_by_reference spans — so the mutant (which differs only by excluding IBR spans) computes an identical figure there. Measured under the mutant: meta.coverage 0.0303 and the message "only 3.0% of the document lies inside an item span (1,003 of 33,061 chars)" — byte-identical to the unmutated run. Such a check would stay GREEN under the very mutant it exists to catch, so it does not satisfy its own acceptance. Every fixture that DOES diverge is one where the warning never fires, so no output carries the thresholded number to assert against. The only (a) that binds is the second one acceptance names — making validate() read the published figure — which is a signature change to the layer-8 entry point with ~10 _demo call sites behind it: a pipeline change requiring a re-measured, re-cited blast radius, which the round-2 brief pre-ruled as more than the finding warrants.' Two of its statements were wrong. (1) The COUNT: `low_item_coverage` fires on one dev fixture (`xref-index-collapse`) and on held-out `intc-2025` and `c-2025` — three committed documents, not one. All three carry zero IBR spans, so the byte-identical-message argument and the falsification of (a)'s FIXTURE-based route are unchanged; only the count was wrong (PR #57 R6, matching ADR-034 §j:504). (2) The COST: 'no output carries the thresholded number to assert against' was false. `validate._demo` already constructs an IBR-only span at `src/sec10k/validate.py:537`, and the `low_item_coverage` message it produces IS such an output — 0.2% unmutated, 0.0% under the mutant. The binding therefore cost two lines on a CI-run self-check with zero blast radius, not a signature change to the layer-8 entry point. That pin is now in the tree; see `tasks/reviews/pr57-r3-resolution.json` and `tasks/reviews/pr57-r3-red.txt`.]
